items.title: Who Sells Shares When a Stock Leaves a Market Index?
items.summary: An index change can prompt tracking funds to sell shares.

items.title: The Week Jensen Huang Fell: How a Spy Scandal Toppled Nvidia’s CEO
items.summary: In a matter of days, the executive synonymous with the AI boom resigned after 33 years amid reports of affairs and suspected Chinese intelligence ties—sending Nvidia’s stock reeling and leaving the chipmaker leaderless.
